name: lines
assumes: an Altium text file (.PrjPcb or .Harness) read as UTF-8 by one of the four readers
every line of the file ends the same way; the cell's terminator ends the key line the reader looks for
end-of-file means the key line is the file's last and has no terminator
'line read' means the reader returns the value the key line sets; 'line missed' means it behaves as if the line were absent
